lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you make that coffee decaf?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː mˌeɪk ðat kˈɒfi dˈiːkaf/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Certainly. Shall I change the one you have already ordered?
lines.ipa: /sˈɜːtənli ʃˌal aɪ tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə wˈɒn juː hav ɔːlɹˌɛdi ˈɔːdəd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Please. I forgot I have had two cups today.
lines.ipa: /plˈiːz aɪ fəɡˈɒt aɪ hav had tˈuː kˈʌps tədˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No problem. I have not started making yours yet.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ pɹˈɒbləm aɪ hɐvnˌɒt stˈɑːtɪd mˌeɪkɪŋ jˈɔːz jˈɛt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is the fruit tea sweet?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðə fɹˈuːt tˈiː swˈiːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It has dried apple in it, but no added sugar.
lines.ipa: /ɪt hɐz dɹˈaɪd ˈapəl ɪn ɪt bˌʌt nˈəʊ ˈadɪd ʃˈʊɡə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could I smell it before I choose?
lines.ipa: /kʊd aɪ smˈɛl ɪt bɪfˌɔːɹ aɪ tʃˈuːz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course. This tin has the blend we use.
lines.ipa: /ɒv kˈɔːs ðɪs tˈɪn hɐz ðə blˈɛnd wiː jˈuːz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I ordered the oat milk because it costs the same on the menu.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈɔːdəd ðɪ ˈəʊt mˈɪlk bɪkˈɒz ɪt kˈɒsts ðə sˈeɪm ɒnðə mˈɛnjuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The printed menu is old. There is an extra charge now.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹˈɪntɪd mˈɛnjuː ɪz ˈəʊld ðeəɹ ɪz ɐn ˈɛkstɹə tʃˈɑːdʒ nˈaʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You should tell people before they order.
lines.ipa: /juː ʃˌʊd tˈɛl pˈiːpəl bɪfˌɔː ðeɪ ˈɔːdə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You are right. I will charge the price you saw.
lines.ipa: /juː ɑː ɹˈaɪt aɪ wɪl tʃˈɑːdʒ ðə pɹˈaɪs juː sˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I am taking these drinks on the bus.
lines.ipa: /aɪɐm tˈeɪkɪŋ ðiːz dɹˈɪŋks ɒnðə bˈʌs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You might need a carrier. There are three cups.
lines.ipa: /juː mˌaɪt nˈiːd ɐ kˈaɹiə ðeəɹˌɑː θɹˈiː kˈʌps/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will it fit in my shopping bag?
lines.ipa: /wɪl ɪt fˈɪt ɪn maɪ ʃˈɒpɪŋ bˈaɡ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Better to carry it flat. I can hold the door for you.
lines.ipa: /bˈɛtə tə kˈaɹi ɪt flˈat aɪ kan hˈəʊld ðə dˈɔː fɔː juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wanted the last slice for my daughter.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wˈɒntɪd ðə lˈast slˈaɪs fɔː maɪ dˈɔːtə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I have just put it aside for another customer.
lines.ipa: /aɪ hav dʒˈʌst pˌʊt ɪt ɐsˈaɪd fɔːɹ ɐnˈʌðə kˈʌstəmə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is there anything else without nuts?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðeəɹ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ˈɛls wɪðˌaʊt nˈʌts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The lemon cake should be suitable, but I will check the label.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈɛmən kˈeɪk ʃˌʊd biː sˈuːtəbəl bˌʌt aɪ wɪl tʃˈɛk ðə lˈeɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This is sweeter than I expected.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs ɪz swˈiːtə ðɐn aɪ ɛkspˈɛktɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you want it without the syrup?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː wˈɒnt ɪt wɪðˌaʊt ðə sˈɪɹʌp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, I only asked for milk.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs aɪ ˈəʊnli ˈaskt fɔː mˈɪlk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I must have misheard. The replacement will take a minute.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈʌstɐv mɪshˈɜːd ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt wɪl tˈeɪk ɐ mˈɪnɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We booked the table by the window.
lines.ipa: /wiː bˈʊkt ðə tˈeɪbəl baɪ ðə wˈɪndəʊ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can see your booking, but the group there is still eating.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan sˈiː jɔː bˈʊkɪŋ bˌʌt ðə ɡɹˈuːp ðeəɹ ɪz stˈɪl ˈiːtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We have a train to catch in an hour.
lines.ipa: /wiː hav ɐ tɹˈeɪn tə kˈatʃ ɪn ɐn ˈaʊə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then let me get another table ready right away.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn lˈɛt mˌiː ɡɛt ɐnˈʌðə tˈeɪbəl ɹˈɛdi ɹˈaɪt ɐwˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can we split the bill between three cards?
lines.ipa: /kan wiː splˈɪt ðə bˈɪl bɪtwˌiːn θɹˈiː kˈɑːdz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Are you dividing it equally?
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ɑː juː dɪvˈaɪdɪŋ ɪt ˈiːkwəli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not quite. I only had the sandwich.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt kwˈaɪt aɪ ˈəʊnli had ðə sˈandwɪtʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tell me which items are yours and I will separate them.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛl mˌiː wˌɪtʃ ˈaɪtəmz ɑː jˈɔːz and aɪ wɪl sˈɛpəɹˌeɪt ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could we stay at the table until two?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː stˈeɪ at ðə tˈeɪbəl ʌntˈɪl tˈuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is reserved from one thirty.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ɪz ɹɪzˈɜːvd fɹɒm wˈɒn θˈɜːti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We will finish before then if the food comes soon.
lines.ipa: /wiː wɪl fˈɪnɪʃ bɪfˌɔː ðˈɛn ɪf ðə fˈuːd kˈʌmz sˈuːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I will check with the kitchen and let you know.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɪl tʃˈɛk wɪððə kˈɪtʃən and lˈɛt juː nˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We waited half an hour without being served.
lines.ipa: /wiː wˈeɪtɪd hˈɑːf ɐn ˈaʊə wɪðˌaʊt bˌiːɪŋ sˈɜːvd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am sorry. Your order did not reach the kitchen.
lines.ipa: /aɪɐm sˈɒɹi jɔːɹ ˈɔːdə dɪdnˌɒt ɹˈiːtʃ ðə kˈɪtʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We cannot stay any longer.
lines.ipa: /wiː kˈanɒt stˈeɪ ˌɛni lˈɒŋɡə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I understand. I will cancel it and return your payment.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˌʌndəstˈand aɪ wɪl kˈansəl ɪt and ɹɪtˈɜːn jɔː pˈeɪmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The machine gave me two single tickets.
lines.ipa: /ðə məʃˈiːn ɡˈeɪv mˌiː tˈuː sˈɪŋɡəl tˈɪkɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you choose a return journey?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː tʃˈuːz ɐ ɹɪtˈɜːn dʒˈɜːni/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought I did. Can you change them?
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt aɪ dˈɪd kan juː tʃˈeɪndʒ ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us check the times before you pay for another ticket.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ˌʌs tʃˈɛk ðə tˈaɪmz bɪfˌɔː juː pˈeɪ fɔːɹ ɐnˈʌðə tˈɪkɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The number twelve is not stopping here today.
lines.ipa: /ðə nˈʌmbə twˈɛlv ɪz nˌɒt stˈɒpɪŋ hˈiə tədˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh, has the route changed?
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊ hɐz ðə ɹˈuːt tʃˈeɪndʒd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There are roadworks. Use the stop outside the library.
lines.ipa: /ðeəɹˌɑː ɹˈəʊdwɜːks jˈuːs ðə stˈɒp aʊtsˈaɪd ðə lˈaɪbɹəɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks. I would have waited here all morning.
lines.ipa: /θˈaŋks aɪ wʊdhɐv wˈeɪtɪd hˈiəɹ ˈɔːl mˈɔːnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I missed the connection because the first train was late.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈɪst ðə kənˈɛkʃən bɪkˈɒz ðə fˈɜːst tɹˈeɪn wɒz lˈeɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let me see both of your tickets.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt mˌiː sˈiː bˈəʊθ ɒv jɔː tˈɪkɪts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I have to pay again?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː aɪ hav tə pˈeɪ ɐɡˈɛn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can take the next service with these tickets.
lines.ipa: /juː kan tˈeɪk ðə nˈɛkst sˈɜːvɪs wɪð ðiːz tˈɪkɪts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My suitcase came off the belt with a broken wheel.
lines.ipa: /maɪ sˈuːtkeɪs kˈeɪm ˈɒf ðə bˈɛlt wɪð ɐ bɹˈəʊkən wˈiːl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was it like that when you checked it in?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ɪt lˈaɪk ðat wɛn juː tʃˈɛkt ɪt ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. I took a photo before the flight.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ aɪ tˈʊk ɐ fˈəʊtəʊ bɪfˌɔː ðə flˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep the photo and fill in this damage report.
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðə fˈəʊtəʊ and fˈɪl ɪn ðɪs dˈamɪdʒ ɹɪpˈɔːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The screen says delayed, but there is no new time.
lines.ipa: /ðə skɹˈiːn sˈɛz dɪlˈeɪd bˌʌt ðeəɹ ɪz nˈəʊ njˈuː tˈaɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The plane has not arrived from Paris yet.
lines.ipa: /ðə plˈeɪn həznɒt ɐɹˈaɪvd fɹɒm pˈaɹɪs jˈɛt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should we still go through security?
lines.ipa: /ʃˌʊd wiː stˈɪl ɡˌəʊ θɹuː sɪkjˈʊəɹɪti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The gate will be announced after the aircraft lands.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə ɡˈeɪt wɪl biː ɐnˈaʊnst ˈaftə ðɪ ˈeəkɹaft lˈandz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you hire helmets with the bikes?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː hˈaɪə hˈɛlmɪts wɪððə bˈaɪks/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They are included. Try this one for size.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ɑːɹ ɪŋklˈuːdɪd tɹˈaɪ ðˈɪswˌɒn fɔː sˈaɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It feels rather loose.
lines.ipa: /ɪt fˈiːlz ɹˈɑːðə lˈuːs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I will get a smaller one and show you the route map.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɪl ɡɛt ɐ smˈɔːlə wˈɒn and ʃˈəʊ juː ðə ɹˈuːt mˈap/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We need a station entrance without stairs.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈiːd ɐ stˈeɪʃən ˈɛntɹəns wɪðˌaʊt stˈeəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The east entrance has a ramp.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈiːst ˈɛntɹəns hɐz ɐ ɹˈamp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is it open this evening?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ɪt ˈəʊpən ðɪs ˈiːvnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Until the last train. I will mark it on your map.
lines.ipa: /ʌntˈɪl ðə lˈast tɹˈeɪn aɪ wɪl mˈɑːk ɪt ˌɒn jɔː mˈap/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The taxi price was higher than the estimate.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈaksi pɹˈaɪs wɒz hˈaɪə ðɐn ðɪ ˈɛstɪmət/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We spent a long time waiting in traffic.
lines.ipa: /wiː spˈɛnt ɐ lˈɒŋ tˈaɪm wˈeɪtɪŋ ɪn tɹˈafɪk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I did not realise waiting time cost extra.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dɪdnˌɒt ɹˈiəlaɪz wˈeɪtɪŋ tˈaɪm kˈɒst ˈɛkstɹə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The rates are printed here. Let us look at them together.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈeɪts ɑː pɹˈɪntɪd hˈiə lˈɛt ˌʌs lˈʊk at ðˌɛm təɡˈɛðə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I bought this ticket yesterday, but the event has been cancelled.
lines.ipa: /aɪ bˈɔːt ðɪs tˈɪkɪt jˈɛstədˌeɪ bˌʌt ðɪ ɪvˈɛnt hˈazbiːn kˈansəld/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you buy it through our website?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː bˈaɪ ɪt θɹuː ˌaʊə wˈɛbsaɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Here is the confirmation.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs hˈiəɹ ɪz ðə kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The refund will go back to the card you used.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈiːfʌnd wɪl ɡˌəʊ bˈak tə ðə kˈɑːd juː jˈuːzd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The coach is cheaper, but it arrives after midnight.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈəʊtʃ ɪz tʃˈiːpə bˌʌt ɪt ɐɹˈaɪvz ˈaftə mˈɪdnaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could we stay with your cousin that night?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː stˈeɪ wɪð jɔː kˈʌzən ðat nˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have asked. Her spare room is free.
lines.ipa: /aɪ hav ˈaskt hɜː spˈeə ɹˈuːm ɪz fɹˈiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the late arrival should not be a problem.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə lˈeɪt ɐɹˈaɪvəl ʃˌʊd nˌɒt biː ɐ pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I booked a twin room, not a double.
lines.ipa: /aɪ bˈʊkt ɐ twˈɪn ɹˈuːm nˌɒtə dˈʌbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let me check the message from your travel company.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt mˌiː tʃˈɛk ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ fɹɒm jɔː tɹˈavəl kˈʌmpəni/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We need two separate beds.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈiːd tˈuː sˈɛpɹət bˈɛdz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can arrange that, but the room will take longer to prepare.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan ɐɹˈeɪndʒ ðˈat bˌʌt ðə ɹˈuːm wɪl tˈeɪk lˈɒŋɡə tə pɹɪpˈeə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We are leaving before breakfast starts.
lines.ipa: /wiː ɑː lˈiːvɪŋ bɪfˌɔː bɹˈɛkfəst stˈɑːts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Would you like a small breakfast to take with you?
lines.ipa: /wʊd juː lˈaɪk ɐ smˈɔːl bɹˈɛkfəst tə tˈeɪk wɪð juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That would help. Can we collect it at five thirty?
lines.ipa: /ðat wʊd hˈɛlp kan wiː kəlˈɛkt ɪt at fˈaɪv θˈɜːti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I will leave it at reception with your room number.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɪl lˈiːv ɪt at ɹɪsˈɛpʃən wɪð jɔː ɹˈuːm nˈʌmbə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The lift makes a loud noise next to our room.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈɪft mˌeɪks ɐ lˈaʊd nˈɔɪz nˈɛkst tʊ ˌaʊə ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can offer you one on the floor above.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan ˈɒfə juː wˈɒn ɒnðə flˈɔːɹ əbˈʌv/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will it be farther from the lift?
lines.ipa: /wɪl ɪt biː fˈɑːðə fɹʌmðə lˈɪft/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, at the end of the corridor, facing the courtyard.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs at ðɪ ˈɛnd ɒvðə kˈɒɹɪdˌɔː fˈeɪsɪŋ ðə kˈɔːtjɑːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our flight is at night. Can we keep the room all afternoon?
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə flˈaɪt ɪz at nˈaɪt kan wiː kˈiːp ðə ɹˈuːm ˈɔːl ˌaftənˈuːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Late checkout is charged by the hour.
lines.ipa: /lˈeɪt tʃˈɛkaʊt ɪz tʃˈɑːdʒd baɪ ðɪ ˈaʊə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How much would four extra hours cost?
lines.ipa: /hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ wʊd fˈɔːɹ ˈɛkstɹəɹ ˈaʊəz kˈɒst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let me work that out before you decide.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt mˌiː wˈɜːk ðat ˈaʊt bɪfˌɔː juː dɪsˈaɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The charger you lent me does not fit.
lines.ipa: /ðə tʃˈɑːdʒə juː lˈɛnt mˌiː dʌznˌɒt fˈɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Can you show me the connection on your phone?
lines.ipa: /kan juː ʃˈəʊ mˌiː ðə kənˈɛkʃən ˌɒn jɔː fˈəʊn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It is this small oval one.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ɪz ðɪs smˈɔːl ˈəʊvəl wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We have another cable for that. Keep the plug.
lines.ipa: /wiː hav ɐnˈʌðə kˈeɪbəl fɔː ðˈat kˈiːp ðə plˈʌɡ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I put my laundry bag outside the door yesterday.
lines.ipa: /aɪ pˌʊt maɪ lˈɔːndɹi bˈaɡ aʊtsˈaɪd ðə dˈɔː jˈɛstədˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There was no room number on it.
lines.ipa: /ðeəwˌɒz nˈəʊ ɹˈuːm nˈʌmbəɹ ˈɒn ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, I forgot to complete the label.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊ aɪ fəɡˈɒt tə kəmplˈiːt ðə lˈeɪbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Describe the clothes and I will check the laundry room.
lines.ipa: /dɪskɹˈaɪb ðə klˈəʊðz and aɪ wɪl tʃˈɛk ðə lˈɔːndɹi ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I need to move the booking to next month.
lines.ipa: /aɪ nˈiːd tə mˈuːv ðə bˈʊkɪŋ tə nˈɛkst mˈʌnθ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your booking allows one free date change.
lines.ipa: /jɔː bˈʊkɪŋ ɐlˈaʊz wˈɒn fɹˈiː dˈeɪt tʃˈeɪndʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do the new dates cost the same?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː ðə njˈuː dˈeɪts kˈɒst ðə sˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The weekend rate is higher, but the weekday rate is unchanged.
lines.ipa: /ðə wiːkˈɛnd ɹˈeɪt ɪz hˈaɪə bˌʌt ðə wˈiːkdeɪ ɹˈeɪt ɪz ʌntʃˈeɪndʒd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think I left my key in a taxi.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɪŋk aɪ lˈɛft maɪ kˈiː ɪn ɐ tˈaksi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We will stop that card from opening your room.
lines.ipa: /wiː wɪl stˈɒp ðat kˈɑːd fɹɒm ˈəʊpənɪŋ jɔː ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I get another straight away?
lines.ipa: /kan aɪ ɡɛt ɐnˈʌðə stɹˈeɪt ɐwˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, after I check your identification.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ˈaftəɹ aɪ tʃˈɛk jɔːɹ aɪdˈɛntɪfɪkˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you send the bill to my company?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː sˈɛnd ðə bˈɪl tə maɪ kˈʌmpəni/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We normally send it to the guest first.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈɔːməli sˈɛnd ɪt tə ðə ɡˈɛst fˈɜːst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I need the company address printed on it.
lines.ipa: /aɪ nˈiːd ðə kˈʌmpəni ɐdɹˈɛs pɹˈɪntɪd ˈɒn ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Write the details here and we will update it.
lines.ipa: /ɹˈaɪt ðə dˈiːteɪlz hˈiə and wiː wɪl ʌpdˈeɪt ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The website said there was a swimming pool.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɛbsaɪt sˈɛd ðeəwˌɒz ɐ swˈɪmɪŋ pˈuːl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There is, but it is closed for repairs this week.
lines.ipa: /ðeəɹˈɪz bˌʌt ɪt ɪz klˈəʊzd fɔː ɹɪpˈeəz ðɪs wˈiːk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nobody told us when we booked.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊbɒdi tˈəʊld ˌʌs wɛn wiː bˈʊkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am sorry. I will ask the manager what we can offer.
lines.ipa: /aɪɐm sˈɒɹi aɪ wɪl ˈask ðə mˈanɪdʒə wɒt wiː kan ˈɒfə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sleeves are fine, but the shirt is tight across my shoulders.
lines.ipa: /ðə slˈiːvz ɑː fˈaɪn bˌʌt ðə ʃˈɜːt ɪz tˈaɪt əkɹˌɒs maɪ ʃˈəʊldəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You might prefer the next size up.
lines.ipa: /juː mˌaɪt pɹɪfˈɜː ðə nˈɛkst sˈaɪz ˈʌp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will it be much longer?
lines.ipa: /wɪl ɪt biː mˈʌtʃ lˈɒŋɡə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only a little. Take both sizes into the changing room.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɐ lˈɪtəl tˈeɪk bˈəʊθ sˈaɪzɪz ˌɪntʊ ðə tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I bought this jacket as a present, but it does not fit him.
lines.ipa: /aɪ bˈɔːt ðɪs dʒˈakɪt az ɐ pɹˈɛzənt bˌʌt ɪt dʌznˌɒt fˈɪt hˌɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was it bought more than a month ago?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ɪt bˈɔːt mˈɔː ðˌanə mˈʌnθ ɐɡˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, last Saturday. I have the receipt.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ lˈast sˈatədˌeɪ aɪ hav ðə ɹɪsˈiːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then he can exchange it or choose something else.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn hiː kan ɛkstʃˈeɪndʒ ɪt ɔː tʃˈuːz sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɛls/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The shelf label says these are on offer.
lines.ipa: /ðə ʃˈɛlf lˈeɪbəl sˈɛz ðiːz ɑːɹ ˌɒn ˈɒfə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only the green packets are reduced.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ðə ɡɹˈiːn pˈakɪts ɑː ɹɪdjˈuːst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The labels are very close together.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈeɪbəlz ɑː vˈɛɹi klˈəʊs təɡˈɛðə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I see what you mean. I will move them apart.
lines.ipa: /aɪ sˈiː wɒt juː mˈiːn aɪ wɪl mˈuːv ðˌɛm ɐpˈɑːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This kettle switches off before the water boils.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs kˈɛtəl swˈɪtʃɪz ˈɒf bɪfˌɔː ðə wˈɔːtə bˈɔɪlz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How long have you had it?
lines.ipa: /hˌaʊ lˈɒŋ hˈav juː hˌadɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just a week. I have only used it twice.
lines.ipa: /dʒˈʌst ɐ wˈiːk aɪ hav ˈəʊnli jˈuːzd ɪt twˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We can test it here and arrange a replacement.
lines.ipa: /wiː kan tˈɛst ɪt hˈiə and ɐɹˈeɪndʒ ɐ ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My order says collected, but I have not been in.
lines.ipa: /maɪ ˈɔːdə sˈɛz kəlˈɛktɪd bˌʌt aɪ hɐvnˌɒt bˌiːn ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is anyone else allowed to collect it for you?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ˈɛnɪwˌɒn ˈɛls ɐlˈaʊd tə kəlˈɛkt ɪt fɔː juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My sister has the same surname.
lines.ipa: /maɪ sˈɪstə hɐz ðə sˈeɪm sˈɜːneɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let me check the signature before we do anything.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt mˌiː tʃˈɛk ðə sˈɪɡnɪtʃə bɪfˌɔː wiː dˈuː ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can you send this gift without showing the price?
lines.ipa: /kan juː sˈɛnd ðɪs ɡˈɪft wɪðˌaʊt ʃˈəʊɪŋ ðə pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We can include a gift receipt instead.
lines.ipa: /wiː kan ɪŋklˈuːd ɐ ɡˈɪft ɹɪsˈiːt ɪnstˈɛd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will my aunt still be able to exchange it?
lines.ipa: /wɪl maɪ ˈant stˈɪl biː ˈeɪbəl tʊ ɛkstʃˈeɪndʒ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The receipt has the details we need.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə ɹɪsˈiːt hɐz ðə dˈiːteɪlz wiː nˈiːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The voucher would not work on your website.
lines.ipa: /ðə vˈaʊtʃə wʊd nˌɒt wˈɜːk ˌɒn jɔː wˈɛbsaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Were you buying something in the sale?
lines.ipa: /wɜː juː bˈaɪɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪnðə sˈeɪl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. A pair of boots.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ɐ pˈeəɹ ɒv bˈuːts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: This offer cannot be used with sale prices. It says so on the back.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs ˈɒfə kˈanɒt biː jˈuːzd wɪð sˈeɪl pɹˈaɪsɪz ɪt sˈɛz sˌəʊ ɒnðə bˈak/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This second-hand bike looks almost new.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs sˈɛkəndhˈand bˈaɪk lˈʊks ˈɔːlməʊst njˈuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The owner used it for one summer.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈəʊnə jˈuːzd ɪt fɔː wˈɒn sˈʌmə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you know when the brakes were checked?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː nˈəʊ wɛn ðə bɹˈeɪks wɜː tʃˈɛkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We checked them when it arrived and kept the report.
lines.ipa: /wiː tʃˈɛkt ðˌɛm wɛn ɪt ɐɹˈaɪvd and kˈɛpt ðə ɹɪpˈɔːt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you remove some of the packaging?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː ɹɪmˈuːv sˌʌm ɒvðə pˈakɪdʒɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can take off the outer plastic, but the glass needs its box.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan tˈeɪk ˈɒf ðɪ ˈaʊtə plˈastɪk bˌʌt ðə ɡlˈas nˈiːdz ɪts bˈɒks/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That makes sense. I was worried about carrying so much rubbish.
lines.ipa: /ðat mˌeɪks sˈɛns aɪ wɒz wˈʌɹid ɐbˌaʊt kˈaɹiɪŋ sˈəʊ mˌʌtʃ ɹˈʌbɪʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We collect the plastic here for recycling.
lines.ipa: /wiː kəlˈɛkt ðə plˈastɪk hˈiə fɔː ɹɪsˈaɪklɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I paid for the book in advance. Why is there an extra charge?
lines.ipa: /aɪ pˈeɪd fəðə bˈʊk ɪn ɐdvˈans wˌaɪ ɪz ðeəɹ ɐn ˈɛkstɹə tʃˈɑːdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You selected delivery rather than collection.
lines.ipa: /juː sɪlˈɛktɪd dɪlˈɪvəɹi ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn kəlˈɛkʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I must have clicked the wrong option.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈʌstɐv klˈɪkt ðə ɹˈɒŋ ˈɒpʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We can change it to collection before it is sent.
lines.ipa: /wiː kan tʃˈeɪndʒ ɪt tə kəlˈɛkʃən bɪfˌɔːɹ ɪt ɪz sˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I seem to be doing the kitchen every week.
lines.ipa: /aɪ sˈiːm təbi dˌuːɪŋ ðə kˈɪtʃən ˈɛvɹɪ wˈiːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I thought you preferred that job.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt juː pɹɪfˈɜːd ðat dʒˈɒb/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not really. I just finish before everyone else.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt ɹˈiəlɪ aɪ dʒˈʌst fˈɪnɪʃ bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ˈɛls/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us write down the jobs and take turns.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ˌʌs ɹˈaɪt dˌaʊn ðə dʒˈɒbz and tˈeɪk tˈɜːnz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The tap only leaks when the hot water is on.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈap ˈəʊnli lˈiːks wɛn ðə hˈɒt wˈɔːtəɹ ɪz ˈɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is useful to know. Did you take a video?
lines.ipa: /ðat ɪz jˈuːsfəl tə nˈəʊ dˈɪd juː tˈeɪk ɐ vˈɪdɪəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. The floor was dry when the plumber came.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə flˈɔː wɒz dɹˈaɪ wɛn ðə plˈʌmə kˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Send the video with the repair request.
lines.ipa: /sˈɛnd ðə vˈɪdɪəʊ wɪððə ɹɪpˈeə ɹɪkwˈɛst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: May I keep your ladder until the weekend?
lines.ipa: /mˈeɪ aɪ kˈiːp jɔː lˈadəɹ ʌntˈɪl ðə wiːkˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I need it on Friday morning.
lines.ipa: /aɪ nˈiːd ɪt ˌɒn fɹˈaɪdeɪ mˈɔːnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can return it on Thursday evening.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan ɹɪtˈɜːn ɪt ˌɒn θˈɜːzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Leave it under the covered part of the garden.
lines.ipa: /lˈiːv ɪt ˌʌndə ðə kˈʌvəd pˈɑːt ɒvðə ɡˈɑːdən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A parcel with your address came to my flat.
lines.ipa: /ɐ pˈɑːsəl wɪð jɔːɹ ɐdɹˈɛs kˈeɪm tə maɪ flˈat/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was my name on the label?
lines.ipa: /wɒz maɪ nˈeɪm ɒnðə lˈeɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, but the flat number was partly hidden.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs bˌʌt ðə flˈat nˈʌmbə wɒz pˈɑːtli hˈɪdən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks for bringing it. I have been looking for it all day.
lines.ipa: /θˈaŋks fɔː bɹˈɪŋɪŋ ɪt aɪ hɐvbɪn lˈʊkɪŋ fɔːɹ ɪt ˈɔːl dˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you let me know before you have a party?
lines.ipa: /kʊd juː lˈɛt mˌiː nˈəʊ bɪfˌɔː juː hav ɐ pˈɑːti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did we make too much noise last night?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd wiː mˌeɪk tˈuː mʌtʃ nˈɔɪz lˈast nˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I had an early shift and could not sleep.
lines.ipa: /aɪ had ɐn ˈɜːlɪ ʃˈɪft and kʊd nˌɒt slˈiːp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am sorry. Next time I will tell you and finish earlier.
lines.ipa: /aɪɐm sˈɒɹi nˈɛkst tˈaɪm aɪ wɪl tˈɛl juː and fˈɪnɪʃ ˈɜːlɪə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does the rent include all the bills?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ðə ɹˈɛnt ɪŋklˈuːd ˈɔːl ðə bˈɪlz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Internet is included, but we share gas and electricity.
lines.ipa: /ˈɪntənˌɛt ɪz ɪŋklˈuːdɪd bˌʌt wiː ʃˈeə ɡˈas and ɪlɛktɹˈɪsɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How much do those usually come to?
lines.ipa: /hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ dˈuː ðəʊz jˈuːʒuːəli kˈʌm tuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can show you the bills from the last three months.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan ʃˈəʊ juː ðə bˈɪlz fɹʌmðə lˈast θɹˈiː mˈʌnθs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The moving van cannot park outside on Saturday.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈuːvɪŋ vˈan kˈanɒt pˈɑːk aʊtsˈaɪd ˌɒn sˈatədˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you asked the neighbours to leave a space?
lines.ipa: /hav juː ˈaskt ðə nˈeɪbəz tə lˈiːv ɐ spˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, but the road will be closed for an event.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs bˌʌt ðə ɹˈəʊd wɪl biː klˈəʊzd fəɹən ɪvˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We may need to move the boxes on Friday instead.
lines.ipa: /wiː mˈeɪ nˈiːd tə mˈuːv ðə bˈɒksɪz ˌɒn fɹˈaɪdeɪ ɪnstˈɛd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our electricity bill has doubled since December.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊəɹ ɪlɛktɹˈɪsɪti bˈɪl hɐz dˈʌbəld sˈɪns dɪsˈɛmbə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We have been using the small heater in the hall.
lines.ipa: /wiː hɐvbɪn jˈuːzɪŋ ðə smˈɔːl hˈiːtəɹ ɪnðə hˈɔːl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I did not think it used so much power.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dɪdnˌɒt θˈɪŋk ɪt jˈuːzd sˈəʊ mˌʌtʃ pˈaʊə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us check it before we use it every evening.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ˌʌs tʃˈɛk ɪt bɪfˌɔː wiː jˈuːz ɪt ˈɛvɹɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The landlord wants us to sign a new agreement this week.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈandlɔːd wˈɒnts ˌʌs tə sˈaɪn ɐ njˈuː ɐɡɹˈiːmənt ðɪs wˈiːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you read the new terms?

lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː mˈuːv wˈɒn tə təmˈɒɹəʊ/

lines.text: That would leave everyone time for a proper break.
lines.ipa: /ðat wʊd lˈiːv ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn tˈaɪm fəɹə pɹˈɒpə bɹˈeɪk/

lines.text: I will ask the person who arranged the last meeting.

lines.ipa: /aɪ pˈeɪd fəɹə klˈas ðat wɒz kˈansəld/

lines.text: That sounds like a better start than a plan you dislike.

lines.text: There is an accessible room beside reception.

lines.text: I would not have found it from that sign.

lines.text: My feedback says I need clearer examples.

lines.text: The sample may show what the teacher means.

lines.ipa: /aɪ sˈaɪnd ˌʌp fəðə ɹˈɒŋ kˈɔːs lˈɛvəl/

lines.text: Ask the office whether you can move to the other group.

lines.text: Will you time my presentation?
lines.ipa: /wɪl juː tˈaɪm maɪ pɹˌɛzəntˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: How long should it be?
lines.ipa: /hˌaʊ lˈɒŋ ʃˌʊd ɪt bˈiː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Five minutes, including the final example.

lines.text: I will raise my hand when you have one minute left.

lines.text: The sound keeps disappearing in the online lesson.

lines.text: Can you hear me when I turn my camera off?

lines.text: Yes, much better now.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs mˈʌtʃ bˈɛtə nˈaʊ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I will send the slides afterwards so you can follow them.

lines.text: Is the study named at the end?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðə stˈʌdi nˈeɪmd at ðɪ ˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There is a short title and a date.
lines.ipa: /ðeəɹ ɪz ɐ ʃˈɔːt tˈaɪtəl and ɐ dˈeɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try searching for both rather than quoting the article itself.
lines.ipa: /tɹˈaɪ sˈɜːtʃɪŋ fɔː bˈəʊθ ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn kwˈəʊtɪŋ ðɪ ˈɑːtɪkəl ɪtsˈɛlf/

lines.text: I have made a revision timetable for every hour.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you left time to eat and take breaks?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not on the first version.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt ɒnðə fˈɜːst vˈɜːʃən/

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could we bring the team meeting forward an hour?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː bɹˈɪŋ ðə tˈiːm mˈiːtɪŋ fˈɔːwəd ɐn ˈaʊə/

lines.text: One person is travelling that morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Would an online call be easier?
lines.ipa: /wʊd ɐn ˈɒnlaɪn kˈɔːl biː ˈiːziə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, if we send the documents in advance.

lines.text: I am finishing three urgent jobs at once.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which one has the earliest deadline?
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ wˈɒn hɐz ðɪ ˈɜːlɪɪst dˈɛdlaɪn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The report, but customers keep calling.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪpˈɔːt bˌʌt kˈʌstəməz kˈiːp kˈɔːlɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can cover the phone while you finish it.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan kˈʌvə ðə fˈəʊn wˌaɪl juː fˈɪnɪʃ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I would like to work from home on Wednesdays.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wʊd lˈaɪk tə wˈɜːk fɹɒm hˈəʊm ˌɒn wˈɛnzdeɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who would cover the front desk?
lines.ipa: /hˌuː wʊd kˈʌvə ðə fɹˈʌnt dˈɛsk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have spoken to Dan. We could swap days.
lines.ipa: /aɪ hav spˈəʊkən tə dˈan wiː kʊd swˈɒp dˈeɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Put the arrangement in writing so the team can see it.
lines.ipa: /pˌʊt ðɪ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt ɪn ɹˈaɪtɪŋ sˌəʊ ðə tˈiːm kan sˈiː ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: These instructions mention a button that is not on my screen.
lines.ipa: /ðiːz ɪnstɹˈʌkʃənz mˈɛnʃən ɐ bˈʌtən ðat ɪz nˌɒt ˌɒn maɪ skɹˈiːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which version of the software are you using?
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ vˈɜːʃən ɒvðə sˈɒftweəɹ ɑː juː jˈuːzɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The one installed this morning.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɒn ɪnstˈɔːld ðɪs mˈɔːnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the guide needs updating. I will show you the new steps.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə ɡˈaɪd nˈiːdz ʌpdˈeɪtɪŋ aɪ wɪl ʃˈəʊ juː ðə njˈuː stˈɛps/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We promised delivery by Friday, but one part has not arrived.
lines.ipa: /wiː pɹˈɒmɪst dɪlˈɪvəɹi baɪ fɹˈaɪdeɪ bˌʌt wˈɒn pˈɑːt həznɒt ɐɹˈaɪvd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have you told the customer?
lines.ipa: /hav juː tˈəʊld ðə kˈʌstəmə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not yet. I was hoping it would arrive today.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt jˈɛt aɪ wɒz hˈəʊpɪŋ ɪt wʊd ɐɹˈaɪv tədˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Give them an update now rather than leave them waiting.
lines.ipa: /ɡˈɪv ðˌɛm ɐn ˈʌpdeɪt nˈaʊ ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn lˈiːv ðˌɛm wˈeɪtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new colleague has not received a door pass.
lines.ipa: /ðə njˈuː kˈɒliːɡ həznɒt ɹɪsˈiːvd ɐ dˈɔː pˈas/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: She cannot get in before reception opens.
lines.ipa: /ʃiː kˈanɒt ɡɛt ɪn bɪfˌɔː ɹɪsˈɛpʃən ˈəʊpənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could someone meet her outside tomorrow?
lines.ipa: /kʊd sˈʌmwɒn mˈiːt hɜːɹ aʊtsˈaɪd təmˈɒɹəʊ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I start early. I can help until the pass arrives.
lines.ipa: /aɪ stˈɑːt ˈɜːlɪ aɪ kan hˈɛlp ʌntˈɪl ðə pˈas ɐɹˈaɪvz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think we misunderstood each other yesterday.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɪŋk wiː mɪsˌʌndəstˈʊd ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə jˈɛstədˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I thought you were asking me to redo everything.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt juː wɜːɹ ˈaskɪŋ mˌiː tə ɹˈiːduː ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I only meant the last two pages.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈəʊnli mˈɛnt ðə lˈast tˈuː pˈeɪdʒɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a relief. I will change those this afternoon.
lines.ipa: /ðat ɪz ɐ ɹɪlˈiːf aɪ wɪl tʃˈeɪndʒ ðəʊz ðɪs ˌaftənˈuːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Some figures in the report are still estimates.
lines.ipa: /sˌʌm fˈɪɡəz ɪnðə ɹɪpˈɔːt ɑː stˈɪl ˈɛstɪmˌeɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then we should mark them clearly.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn wiː ʃˌʊd mˈɑːk ðˌɛm klˈiəli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will that make the report look unfinished?
lines.ipa: /wɪl ðat mˌeɪk ðə ɹɪpˈɔːt lˈʊk ʌnfˈɪnɪʃt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It will make it easier to read the figures correctly.
lines.ipa: /ɪt wɪl mˌeɪk ɪt ˈiːziə tə ɹˈiːd ðə fˈɪɡəz kəɹˈɛktli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We enter the same address into three different forms.
lines.ipa: /wiː ˈɛntə ðə sˈeɪm ɐdɹˈɛs ˌɪntʊ θɹˈiː dˈɪfɹənt fˈɔːmz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could we copy it from the first one?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː kˈɒpɪ ɪt fɹʌmðə fˈɜːst wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I tried, but the boxes are different.
lines.ipa: /aɪ tɹˈaɪd bˌʌt ðə bˈɒksɪz ɑː dˈɪfɹənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Show me an example. There may be a simpler way.
lines.ipa: /ʃˈəʊ mˌiː ɐn ɛɡzˈampəl ðeə mˈeɪ biː ɐ sˈɪmplə wˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I cannot find the notes for the project you are handing over.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈanɒt fˈaɪnd ðə nˈəʊts fəðə pɹˈɒdʒɛkt juː ɑː hˈandɪŋ ˈəʊvə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They are in the shared folder under the client name.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ɑːɹ ɪnðə ʃˈeəd fˈəʊldəɹ ˌʌndə ðə klˈaɪənt nˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which file has the latest changes?
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ fˈaɪl hɐz ðə lˈeɪtɪst tʃˈeɪndʒɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The one dated Tuesday. I will rename it more clearly.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɒn dˈeɪtɪd tjˈuːzdeɪ aɪ wɪl ɹɪnˈeɪm ɪt mˈɔː klˈiəli/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I changed my password and now the phone will not sign in.
lines.ipa: /aɪ tʃˈeɪndʒd maɪ pˈaswɜːd and nˈaʊ ðə fˈəʊn wɪl nˌɒt sˈaɪn ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is the phone still using the saved password?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðə fˈəʊn stˈɪl jˈuːzɪŋ ðə sˈeɪvd pˈaswɜːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It fills the box automatically.
lines.ipa: /ɪt fˈɪlz ðə bˈɒks ˌɔːtəmˈatɪkli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Remove that saved entry and enter the new password yourself.
lines.ipa: /ɹɪmˈuːv ðat sˈeɪvd ˈɛntɹi and ˈɛntə ðə njˈuː pˈaswɜːd jɔːsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The document link works for me, but not for the client.
lines.ipa: /ðə dˈɒkjuːmənt lˈɪŋk wˈɜːks fɔː mˌiː bˌʌt nˌɒt fəðə klˈaɪənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you share it with their exact email address?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː ʃˈeəɹ ɪt wɪð ðeəɹ ɛɡzˈakt ˈiːmeɪl ɐdɹˈɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used the address from an old message.
lines.ipa: /aɪ jˈuːzd ðɪ ɐdɹˈɛs fɹɒm ɐn ˈəʊld mˈɛsɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask which account they are using before changing the access.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wˌɪtʃ ɐkˈaʊnt ðeɪ ɑː jˈuːzɪŋ bɪfˌɔː tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ ðɪ ˈaksɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My backup finished, but several folders are empty.
lines.ipa: /maɪ bˈakʌp fˈɪnɪʃt bˌʌt sˈɛvɹəl fˈəʊldəz ɑːɹ ˈɛmpti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the files finish copying before you unplugged the drive?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə fˈaɪlz fˈɪnɪʃ kˈɒpɪɪŋ bɪfˌɔː juː ʌnplˈʌɡd ðə dɹˈaɪv/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I closed the lid when the screen went dark.
lines.ipa: /aɪ klˈəʊzd ðə lˈɪd wɛn ðə skɹˈiːn wɛnt dˈɑːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us compare the folders before deleting anything.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ˌʌs kəmpˈeə ðə fˈəʊldəz bɪfˌɔː dɪlˈiːtɪŋ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I turned off notifications, but the app still shows a red number.
lines.ipa: /aɪ tˈɜːnd ˈɒf nˌəʊtɪfɪkˈeɪʃənz bˌʌt ðɪ ˈap stˈɪl ʃˈəʊz ɐ ɹˈɛd nˈʌmbə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a separate setting for the app icon.
lines.ipa: /ðat ɪz ɐ sˈɛpɹət sˈɛtɪŋ fəðɪ ˈap ˈaɪkɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I thought one switch covered everything.
lines.ipa: /aɪ θˈɔːt wˈɒn swˈɪtʃ kˈʌvəd ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The options are confusing. I will show you where it is.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɒpʃənz ɑː kənfjˈuːzɪŋ aɪ wɪl ʃˈəʊ juː wˌeəɹ ɪt ˈɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The update moved my favourite tools.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈʌpdeɪt mˈuːvd maɪ fˈeɪvɹɪt tˈuːlz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They are under the small menu on the right.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ɑːɹ ˌʌndə ðə smˈɔːl mˈɛnjuː ɒnðə ɹˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I put them back on the main screen?
lines.ipa: /kan aɪ pˌʊt ðˌɛm bˈak ɒnðə mˈeɪn skɹˈiːn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Some of them. There is an option to choose your shortcuts.
lines.ipa: /sˌʌm ɒv ðˈɛm ðeəɹ ɪz ɐn ˈɒpʃən tə tʃˈuːz jɔː ʃˈɔːtkʌts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The connection drops whenever I move into the back room.
lines.ipa: /ðə kənˈɛkʃən dɹˈɒps wɛnˌɛvəɹ aɪ mˈuːv ˌɪntʊ ðə bˈak ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does it happen on your phone as well?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ɪt hˈapən ˌɒn jɔː fˈəʊn az wˈɛl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, but both devices work near the front door.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs bˌʌt bˈəʊθ dɪvˈaɪsɪz wˈɜːk nˌiə ðə fɹˈʌnt dˈɔː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tell support those details. It may help them find the problem.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛl səpˈɔːt ðəʊz dˈiːteɪlz ɪt mˈeɪ hˈɛlp ðˌɛm fˈaɪnd ðə pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The website will not let me reject just the extra cookies.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɛbsaɪt wɪl nˌɒt lˈɛt mˌiː ɹɪdʒˈɛkt dʒˈʌst ðɪ ˈɛkstɹə kˈʊkiz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There should be a way to change the choices.
lines.ipa: /ðeə ʃˌʊd biː ɐ wˈeɪ tə tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə tʃˈɔɪsɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can only see an accept button.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan ˈəʊnli sˈiː ɐn ɐksˈɛpt bˈʌtən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try the settings link before agreeing to anything.
lines.ipa: /tɹˈaɪ ðə sˈɛtɪŋz lˈɪŋk bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐɡɹˈiːɪŋ tʊ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Making the text bigger has hidden the save button.
lines.ipa: /mˌeɪkɪŋ ðə tˈɛkst bˈɪɡə hɐz hˈɪdən ðə sˈeɪv bˈʌtən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Can you scroll further down the page?
lines.ipa: /kan juː skɹˈəʊl fˈɜːðə dˌaʊn ðə pˈeɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There is no more space below it.
lines.ipa: /ðeəɹ ɪz nˈəʊmˌɔː spˈeɪs bɪlˈəʊ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That needs reporting. Larger text should not block the controls.
lines.ipa: /ðat nˈiːdz ɹɪpˈɔːtɪŋ lˈɑːdʒə tˈɛkst ʃˌʊd nˌɒt blˈɒk ðə kəntɹˈəʊlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The tool wrote a summary of a book it seems not to know.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈuːl ɹˈəʊt ɐ sˈʌməɹi əvə bˈʊk ɪt sˈiːmz nˌɒt tə nˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What makes you think that?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt mˌeɪks juː θˈɪŋk ðˈat/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It gave two characters different names.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ɡˈeɪv tˈuː kˈaɹɪktəz dˈɪfɹənt nˈeɪmz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use the book itself to check the summary before sharing it.
lines.ipa: /jˈuːs ðə bˈʊk ɪtsˈɛlf tə tʃˈɛk ðə sˈʌməɹi bɪfˌɔː ʃˈeəɹɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I cancelled the subscription, but another payment is due.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈansəld ðə sʌbskɹˈɪpʃən bˌʌt ɐnˈʌðə pˈeɪmənt ɪz djˈuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: When does the current period end?
lines.ipa: /wˌɛn dˈʌz ðə kˈʌɹənt pˈiəɹɪəd ˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Tomorrow. The message only says cancellation requested.
lines.ipa: /təmˈɒɹəʊ ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ ˈəʊnli sˈɛz kˌansɪlˈeɪʃən ɹɪkwˈɛstɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for written confirmation of the final date.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fɔː ɹˈɪtən kɒnfəmˈeɪʃən ɒvðə fˈaɪnəl dˈeɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our neighbour puts plastic bags in the glass bin.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə nˈeɪbə pˌʊts plˈastɪk bˈaɡz ɪnðə ɡlˈas bˈɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps they have not seen the new collection leaflet.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ðeɪ hɐvnˌɒt sˈiːn ðə njˈuː kəlˈɛkʃən lˈiːflɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could we put a copy by the bins?
lines.ipa: /kʊd wiː pˌʊt ɐ kˈɒpɪ baɪ ðə bˈɪnz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A picture of what goes where might be more useful.
lines.ipa: /ɐ pˈɪktʃəɹ ɒv wɒt ɡəʊz wˌeə mˌaɪt biː mˈɔː jˈuːsfəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Water is running from the tap near the playground.
lines.ipa: /wˈɔːtəɹ ɪz ɹˈʌnɪŋ fɹʌmðə tˈap nˌiə ðə plˈeɪɡɹaʊnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I reported it yesterday, but nobody has come.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹɪpˈɔːtɪd ɪt jˈɛstədˌeɪ bˌʌt nˈəʊbɒdi hɐz kˈʌm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you include the exact location?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː ɪŋklˈuːd ðɪ ɛɡzˈakt ləʊkˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only the park name. I will add the gate number.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ðə pˈɑːk nˈeɪm aɪ wɪl ˈad ðə ɡˈeɪt nˈʌmbə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The tree planting day is next Saturday.
lines.ipa: /ðə tɹˈiː plˈantɪŋ dˈeɪ ɪz nˈɛkst sˈatədˌeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Who looks after the trees after that?
lines.ipa: /hˌuː lˈʊks ˈaftə ðə tɹˈiːz ˈaftə ðˈat/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have not heard anything about watering.
lines.ipa: /aɪ hɐvnˌɒt hˈɜːd ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ɐbˌaʊt wˈɔːtəɹɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We should ask before we put them in the ground.
lines.ipa: /wiː ʃˌʊd ˈask bɪfˌɔː wiː pˌʊt ðˌɛm ɪnðə ɡɹˈaʊnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We filled all the bags before reaching the far end of the park.
lines.ipa: /wiː fˈɪld ˈɔːl ðə bˈaɡz bɪfˌɔː ɹˈiːtʃɪŋ ðə fˈɑːɹ ˈɛnd ɒvðə pˈɑːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do we have more bags in the van?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː wiː hav mˈɔː bˈaɡz ɪnðə vˈan/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, but there is no space to leave the full ones.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs bˌʌt ðeəɹ ɪz nˈəʊ spˈeɪs tə lˈiːv ðə fˈʊl wˌɒnz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Call the collection team and agree where to put them.
lines.ipa: /kˈɔːl ðə kəlˈɛkʃən tˈiːm and ɐɡɹˈiː wˌeə tə pˈʊt ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I would like a stall at the local market.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wʊd lˈaɪk ɐ stˈɔːl at ðə lˈəʊkəl mˈɑːkɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you need electricity for what you sell?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː juː nˈiːd ɪlɛktɹˈɪsɪti fɔː wɒt juː sˈɛl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only a small light.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɐ smˈɔːl lˈaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask about the connection fee as well as the table price.
lines.ipa: /ˈask ɐbˌaʊt ðə kənˈɛkʃən fˈiː az wˈɛl az ðə tˈeɪbəl pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The shared tool shelf is full of things nobody uses.
lines.ipa: /ðə ʃˈeəd tˈuːl ʃˈɛlf ɪz fˈʊl ɒv θˈɪŋz nˈəʊbɒdi jˈuːsɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have the owners labelled them?
lines.ipa: /hav ðɪ ˈəʊnəz lˈeɪbəld ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Some tools do not have names on them.
lines.ipa: /sˌʌm tˈuːlz duːnˌɒt hav nˈeɪmz ˈɒn ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us make a list before moving anything.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ˌʌs mˌeɪk ɐ lˈɪst bɪfˌɔː mˈuːvɪŋ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We bought reusable cups, but people keep taking them home.
lines.ipa: /wiː bˈɔːt ɹiːjˈuːzəbəl kˈʌps bˌʌt pˈiːpəl kˈiːp tˈeɪkɪŋ ðˌɛm hˈəʊm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps they think the cups are included in the drink price.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ðeɪ θˈɪŋk ðə kˈʌps ɑːɹ ɪŋklˈuːdɪd ɪnðə dɹˈɪŋk pɹˈaɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There is no sign saying they should return them.
lines.ipa: /ðeəɹ ɪz nˈəʊ sˈaɪn sˈeɪɪŋ ðeɪ ʃˌʊd ɹɪtˈɜːn ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A clear return point would help too.
lines.ipa: /ɐ klˈiə ɹɪtˈɜːn pˈɔɪnt wʊd hˈɛlp tˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The proposed bike route ends at a busy junction.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹəpˈəʊzd bˈaɪk ɹˈuːt ˈɛndz atə bˈɪzi dʒˈʌŋkʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is there a crossing nearby?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðeəɹ ɐ kɹˈɒsɪŋ niəbˈaɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, but it is around the corner.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs bˌʌt ɪt ɪz ɐɹˈaʊnd ðə kˈɔːnə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The route map should show the safe way across.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈuːt mˈap ʃˌʊd ʃˈəʊ ðə sˈeɪf wˈeɪ əkɹˈɒs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We only received survey replies from people using the website.
lines.ipa: /wiː ˈəʊnli ɹɪsˈiːvd sˈɜːveɪ ɹɪplˈaɪz fɹɒm pˈiːpəl jˈuːzɪŋ ðə wˈɛbsaɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Some older residents asked for paper copies.
lines.ipa: /sˌʌm ˈəʊldə ɹˈɛzɪdənts ˈaskt fɔː pˈeɪpə kˈɒpɪz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could the library give them out?
lines.ipa: /kʊd ðə lˈaɪbɹəɹi ɡˈɪv ðˌɛm ˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And collect them, so nobody has to go online.
lines.ipa: /and kəlˈɛkt ðˌɛm sˌəʊ nˈəʊbɒdi hɐz tə ɡˌəʊ ˈɒnlaɪn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two groups want the same small grant.
lines.ipa: /tˈuː ɡɹˈuːps wˈɒnt ðə sˈeɪm smˈɔːl ɡɹˈant/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do they know how the money will be awarded?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː ðeɪ nˈəʊ hˌaʊ ðə mˈʌni wɪl biː ɐwˈɔːdɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: One group thinks it is first come, first served.
lines.ipa: /wˈɒn ɡɹˈuːp θˈɪŋks ɪt ɪz fˈɜːst kˈʌm fˈɜːst sˈɜːvd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We need to publish the rules before making a choice.
lines.ipa: /wiː nˈiːd tə pˈʌblɪʃ ðə ɹˈuːlz bɪfˌɔː mˌeɪkɪŋ ɐ tʃˈɔɪs/
